svg.title: Drugan–Kleene immersed shrinking families
svg.desc: Meridian construction diagram: closed loops and returning/escaping branches distinguish the four topologies. The three panels apply the exact shrinker time scaling to schematic profiles, not to a numerically certified complete Drugan–Kleene shrinker.
svg.text: Common spatial scale · teal: profile / slice · rust: second piece / asymptote · gray: reference geometry
